about.title: About Battle Pack: Epic Dawn
paragraphs: Battle Pack: Epic Dawn is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 24 May 2012, in the ZEXAL era. It has 220 cards, and with the 220 other rarities there are 440 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 220 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 440, adding the 220 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
